accepted_ambiguities: Loading/loaded Russian passive wording and preview/viewing are context-sensitive;clarity risks are not silently converted into confirmed forward defects.
Broad Russian расшифровать can mean decode;English decrypt is narrower. Back decryption is recorded without inventing a forward encryption claim.
Shikaku/Sikaku transliteration and region/area synonyms are not by themselves brand/geography defects.
Directional loading verbs are reviewed in local-file/privacy/export context;new independent back direction errors are forward-hash-bound.
Five localized unit-symbol spellings are linguistically meaningful but unproved by the frozen contract;no fake changed-value grade.
